jobs.title: Concrete Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Concrete Project Coordinator Join Our Team!**
-----------------------------------------------

### **About Us**

Rick Hamm Construction is at the forefront of commercial, industrial, and heavy civil construction projects. With a reputation for excellence, we pride ourselves on quality, precision, and efficiency. We are looking for an experienced Concrete Project Coordinator to be part of our dynamic team.

### **Job Overview**

As a Concrete Project Coordinator, you will play a crucial role in supporting our estimators, superintendents and project management teams to ensure successful planning, execution, and completion of projects. This is a full-time role, but there is a part-time option as well. The position demands someone who is highly organized, detail-oriented, and capable of multitasking in a fast-paced environment.

### **Qualifications**

* High school diploma or equivalent (Bachelor's degree in construction management or related field is a plus).
* 5 years of experience in concrete construction, preferably in commercial, industrial, or heavy civil projects.
* Ability to read and interpret construction drawings, structural details, and specifications.
* Excellent verbal and written communication abilities.
* Proficiency with construction management software (e.g., Procore, Bluebeam, PlanGrid) and Microsoft Office Suite.
* A proactive and team-oriented mindset.
* Strong organizational, problem-solving, and multitasking skills.
* Meticulous and detail-oriented, with a proven ability to ensure accuracy, thoroughness, and consistency.
* Must be available to work in the office daily.

### **Responsibilities**

* Organize and maintain accurate project records and documentation related to concrete activities.
* Support the project team with coordination, scheduling and communication with vendors, subcontractors, and clients.
* Assist the project team with the organization of On-Screen Takeoff and project management software.
* Support the project team in responding to and sending out RFPs and RFQs.
* Conduct site visits and capture photographs as required for project documentation and progress tracking.
* Prepare and manage RFIs, submittals, and change orders related to the concrete scope of work.
* Work closely with field crews to resolve technical or constructability issues promptly.
* Participate in project meetings with clients, design teams, and subcontractors to provide updates on concrete operations.
* Provide general administrative support to ensure the project runs smoothly.

### **What We Offer**

* Pay Range: $70,000/year.
* Full-Time Position (Part-Time optional).
* Working Hours: 6:00 AM - 3:00 PM (with 30 min lunch).
* Benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision, Retirement Savings.

### **Join Us**

If you have the expertise and passion for construction, especially in concrete project coordination, we would love to hear from you! Apply today and be a part of our journey in building excellence.

jobs.title: Youth Alumni Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
Program: Workforce Development

Department: Youth Services

Reports to: Sr. Program Manager, Workforce Development

Status: 100%, Full-Time, Non Exempt

Probation: 90 days

Benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision; also including Life Insurance, Long-Term Disability, Employee Assistance Program, and a 403(b) Retirement Plan

Center’s Mission:

Building a world where LGBT people thrive as healthy, equal, and complete members of society.

**DEPARTMENT SUMMARY:**The Youth Center serves youth up to the age of 24 who are currently at-risk of or experiencing homelessness. The Youth Center offers services in an LGBTQ+ safe and affirming environment and serves as an entry point to assist youth making the transition from homelessness to housing. Our services include meals, clothing, support groups, a charter high school, GED and college prep program, employment preparation, training and placement program, case management, counseling, a crisis shelter and a transitional living program (TLP). Our community-based programs include services for youth at home, in school, or in systems of care.

**JOB SUMMARY**: As an integral part of the Workforce Development team, the Youth Alumni Program Coordinator coordinates retention strategies that transition participants from vocational training into active alumni engagement. This role collaborates across departments to support youth aging out of programs, provides supportive services and mentorship coordination, and strengthens long-term participant stability. This position tracks alumni outcomes, manages data and reporting requirements, oversees alumni communications and events, and ensures continuous program evaluation and improvement to meet organizational and funder goals.

**ESSENTIAL****FUNCTIONS**

**% of Role**

25

**Program Coordination & Strategy**

* Coordinate and implement a comprehensive retention strategy that transitions vocational training participants into alumni status
* Lead a peer mentorship program connecting alumni with current youth participants
* Evaluate alumni program initiatives and events, identifying successes, challenges, and recommendations for improvement
* Support strategic development of the aged-out system to ensure continuity of services for youth transitioning from all department programs

35

**Participant Engagement & Support Services**

* Partner with Workforce Development team coordinate and strengthen participant engagement and retention
* Provide appointment-based supportive services to alumni and connect them to appropriate community resources
* Partner with the Mentoring Navigator to ensure all alumni are matched with mentors
* Build rapport with participants to promote progression from program enrollment to active alumni involvement

10

**Data Management & Reporting**

* Maintain and coordinate alumni database systems in partnership with Youth Academy and IT teams to ensure accurate tracking of youth transitions
* Track and report on alumni outcomes related to housing, employment, health, and overall stability
* Prepare monthly and funder-required reports detailing alumni program performance
* Collect, analyze, and distribute program evaluations to leadership, staff, and the Steering Committee

10

**Event Coordination**

* Plan and coordinate alumni events, collaborating with task force as necessary
* Ensure events align with program goals and participant engagement strategies
* Provide regular updates to leadership on alumni engagement and event outcomes

20

**Administrative & Operational Support**

* Regularly communicate with alumni via email to ensure they are receiving updates, resources, and support
* Maintain organized program documentation and records
* Support cross-departmental collaboration to ensure smooth program operations
* Perform additional duties as assigned to meet organizational and funder requirements

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Knowledge of or experience working with the LGBTQ community and familiarity with issues of particular relevance to LGBTQ people
* A passion for the Center’s work and its mission to make the world a better place for LGBTQ people
* Minimum 2 years’ experience in program development, volunteer management and working with at-risk youth
* Experience in psychology, sociology or related field or bachelor’s degree
* Working knowledge of the Los Angeles County network of social services
* Strong communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills
* Proficiency with Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and databases
* Sensitivity to and appreciation of the needs and challenges of gay, lesbian, transgender, bisexual and questioning youth and other marginalized and at-risk youth
* Ability to work effectively and collegially with people of diverse education levels, abilities, races, ethnicities, spiritual affiliations, gender identities, ages and sexual orientations
* Available to work a flexible schedule that includes weekends and evenings
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively with people of diverse races, ethnicities, nationalities, sexual orientations, gender identities, gender expression, socio-economic backgrounds, religions, ages, English-speaking abilities, immigration status, and physical abilities in a multicultural environment

The Los Angeles LGBT Center is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to fostering diversity within its staff. Applications are encouraged from all persons regardless of their race, color, ancestry, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, sex, pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions, religion, disability, age, military or veteran status, including status as a victim of domestic violence, assault or stalking, genetic information (including family medical history), political affiliation or activities, medical or health conditions, and marital status.

Mindful movement. It's at the core of why we do what we do at ALO—it's our calling. Because mindful movement in the studio leads to better living. It changes who yogis are off the mat, making their lives and their communities better. That's the real meaning of studio-to-street: taking the consciousness from practice on the mat and putting it into practice in life.

**OVERVIEW**

The Construction Program Specialist supports the successful execution of ALO's Store Development projects by coordinating timelines, documentation, and communications across Construction, Store Design, and Real Estate. This role ensures alignment and efficiency throughout the project lifecycle—from site approval through store opening—by managing key systems, maintaining schedules, and fostering collaboration across all functional partners.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

Project Coordination & Scheduling

* Coordinate and track all project milestones, deliverables, and dependencies within the master project schedule (Smartsheet or similar)

* Communicate milestone deadlines and critical path updates to stakeholders across departments.
* Identify potential schedule risks and collaborate with internal teams to develop solutions.
* Coordinate project kickoffs, status updates, and cross-functional meetings; document and distribute meeting notes and action items.

Platform & System Administration

* Serve as primary administrator for Store Development platforms, including Procore, Smartsheet, and shared project databases.
* Manage system setup, project creation, user permissions, and access for internal and external stakeholders.
* Maintain standardized folder structures and ensure ongoing compliance with file management policies.
* Partner with IT and project teams to streamline workflows, integrate data between platforms, and improve reporting accuracy.
* Support ongoing development of dashboards, reports, and templates to enhance visibility and accountability across programs.
* Train and support team members and vendors on platform use and best practices.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

* Facilitate effective communication and coordination across Real Estate, Store Design, Construction, Finance, Facilities, and Operations teams.
* Partner with cross-program leads to align timelines, deliverables, and project dependencies across multiple initiatives (e.g., remodels, pop-ups, relocations).
* Act as a liaison between landlords, vendors, and internal partners to ensure smooth handoffs and clear documentation flow.
* Support the integration of sustainability, technology, and brand standards into all project processes.

Administrative & Operational Support

* Obtain, track, and file critical documents from Real Estate, landlords, and consultants.
* Coordinate utility setups and partner with Accounts Payable to ensure timely account activation and billing accuracy.
* Support vendor onboarding, purchase order tracking, and contract management as needed.
* Maintain confidentiality and professionalism while handling sensitive company and project information.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* 2–4 years of experience in construction, store development, design coordination, or a related field.
* Bachelor's degree preferred.
* Proficiency with Procore, Smartsheet, and Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Project).
* Strong organizational and communication skills, with acute attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Collaborative mindset with a proactive, professional, and solution-oriented approach.

The base salary range for this position is $75,000 - $85,000 per year which represents the current range for the base salary for this exempt position. Please note that actual salaries will vary based on factors including but not limited to location, experience, and performance. As such, on occasion and when applicable, there is the possibility that the final, agreed-upon base salary may be outside of the upper end of the range. This vital role offers the opportunity to coordinate seamless real estate operations, support sales initiatives, and foster strong client relationships. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, possess a passion for real estate, and excel at multitasking, this is your chance to make a meaningful impact while growing professionally in a vibrant industry.

**Position Summary**

The Real Estate Administrative Coordinator provides comprehensive administrative and operational support to Apex Realty's leasing, property management, and executive teams. The position is responsible for maintaining accurate property and leasing documentation, coordinating leasing transactions and Letters of Intent (LOIs), supporting lease negotiations and renewals, tracking Property Manager workflows, facilitating tenant transitions, and preparing portfolio-level reports for executive review.

The position also supports broker coordination, vendor administration, and internal operational processes to ensure documentation, deadlines, and required deliverables are completed accurately and efficiently.

Additionally, the role contributes to Apex Realty's continued modernization by researching and utilizing technology, artificial intelligence (AI), digital resources, and process-improvement tools to enhance administrative efficiency and streamline company workflows.

The successful candidate will be highly organized, detail-oriented, technologically proficient, and capable of managing multiple administrative priorities while coordinating with internal departments and external business partners.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Leasing & Transaction Administration**

* Maintain, organize, and update property and leasing documentation within the Apex server and AppFolio, ensuring records are accurate, complete, and readily accessible.
* Coordinate documentation required throughout the Letter of Intent (LOI) process, including tenant financial statements, personal financial statements, business experience, ownership information, and other due-diligence materials.
* Prepare draft leases, offers, counteroffers, lease amendments, extensions, renewal proposals, and related leasing documents for executive and legal review.
* Provide administrative and documentation support throughout lease and lease renewal negotiations.
* Track leasing activity, pending approvals, outstanding documentation, execution status, and transaction deadlines.
* Research and identify prospective commercial real estate brokers and submit recommendations to Executive Leadership.
* Prepare broker listing agreements for review and approval, and maintain broker correspondence, marketing reports, and related documentation.
* Coordinate communications among brokers, tenants, Property Managers, and Executive Leadership regarding leasing transactions.

**2. Property Management Administrative Coordination**

* Provide administrative and workflow support to Property Managers to facilitate timely completion of assigned responsibilities.
* Monitor outstanding action items, deadlines, documentation requirements, and operational deliverables.
* Follow up with Property Managers regarding incomplete documentation, pending assignments, and required updates.
* Maintain tracking systems and administrative records to support operational accountability.
* Identify overdue or unresolved matters and communicate them to the appropriate supervisor or Executive Leadership.
* Assist with the coordination and implementation of established company procedures and administrative workflows.

**3. Tenant Move-In & Move-Out Coordination**

* Coordinate administrative requirements associated with tenant move-ins and move-outs in accordance with company procedures.
* Assist with the preparation, collection, and tracking of tenant documentation.

* Communicate with Property Managers, Accounting, and other departments regarding required tenant transition documentation.
* Monitor completion of move-in and move-out administrative requirements and follow up on outstanding items.
* Maintain accurate tenant records and supporting documentation.

**4. Portfolio Reporting & Executive Support**

Prepare, maintain, and present routine portfolio reports to the Executive Vice President, including:

* Property vacancies and current leasing activity.
* Tenant delinquencies and outstanding balances.
* Month-to-month tenants.
* Upcoming lease expirations and renewal opportunities.

* Other operational reports requested by Executive Leadership.

Additional responsibilities include:

jobs.description:
**USGBC-CA Development Coordinator**

The Development Coordinator plays a vital role in advancing the mission of USGBC California by driving key operational, donor engagement, and business development functions across corporate sponsorships and individual giving. Reporting directly to the Chief Development Officer, this role executes sponsorship fulfillment across 10 California regions, coordinates logistics for signature fundraising events (California Green Building Conference and Green Gala), manages individual giving appeals, and supports business development for leading market initiatives. Embracing our core values of being "Rooted in Kindness" and "Humans in Service to One Another," this position ensures seamless donor stewardship and database management to support annual funding goals while building lasting relationships with both current and future partners.

**Essential Functions and Responsibilities**

* **Fundraising Execution & Support:** Coordinate fundraising identification, cultivation, asks, stewardship fulfillment, and benefit tracking across fundraising initiatives, including statewide and regional funding.
* **Signature Event Fundraising Logistics:** Support event fundraising execution for statewide and regional events (ex. California Green Building Conference, Green Gala, etc.), coordinating sponsor collateral, benefit execution, and post-event funder follow-up.
* **Campaign Execution:** Coordinate administrative and digital workflows for giving programs, market transformation initiatives, and events utilizing automations and tech stack (monday, mail merge, Donorbox, etc.)
* **CRM Management & Funder Stewardship:** Coordinate and maintain strong funder data (ex. Copper CRM), process incoming gifts, run targeted appeal queries, and issue timely acknowledgment letters and tax receipts.
* **Business and Partnership Development:** Actively build relationships with both current and potential future partners, with a focus on how to implement initiatives and programs that transform the real estate industry.
* **Cross-Departmental Collaboration:** Act in service to the broader team by pulling collateral, gathering funder metrics, and supporting cross-functional initiatives with a "how can I help?" mindset.
* Other duties as assigned

**Success in this role looks like**

* **Creative Thinking:** Generate original ideas and propose innovative solutions anchored in fundraising best practices; proactively reach out to colleagues to brainstorm when encountering challenges; value diverse perspectives.
* **Time Management & Prioritization:** Plan and manage work deliverables efficiently maximizing effectiveness, coordinate multiple fundraising priorities and deadlines, and keep leadership informed while escalating potential conflicts proactively.
* **Team Mentality:** Understand organizational priorities and cross-functional workflows to support colleagues in reaching their goals without creating operational bottlenecks.
* **Empathy:** Seek to understand the needs of funders, members, and teammates, fostering compassion, awareness, and respect in every interaction.
* **Results Orientation:** Take personal responsibility for driving outcomes, maintaining flexibility and focus to adapt to new challenges and achieve funding targets.

**Qualifications/Skills**

* **Experience:** 2–3 years of hands-on fundraising, donor relations, or event sponsorship coordination experience required.
* **Technical Literacy:** Proficiency with nonprofit CRM systems and automations (Copper/Raiser's Edge), project management software, and digital marketing platforms required.
* **Communication:** Excellent written and verbal communication skills for drafting compelling funder appeals, sponsor correspondence, and impact updates.
* **Mission & Values Alignment:** Strong dedication to climate action and sustainability, paired with a spirit of open collaboration, warmth, and active listening.

**Work Requirements**

* **Travel:** Occasional statewide travel required for major conferences, galas, and community events.
* **Physical/Mental Requirements:** Safely lift and transport event materials up to 25 lbs; stand or walk for extended intervals during events; maintain focus and manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.

**TIME COMMITMENT & COMPENSATION:**

This is a full-time, hybrid position. Location: Los Angeles. Annual salary range is $65,000-$75,000.

We offer a full benefits package with discretionary unlimited vacation, 14 paid holidays, healthcare coverage (including vision and dental), 401k, and life insurance. We have parental leave and offer an annual bonus program while working in a flexible, hybrid structure.

Staff has the availability to attend our trainings and other industry events in our network and we also offer reimbursement for continuing education. We strive to have a work-life balance where we work to live and have regular team-building events to maintain our culture.

**ABOUT USGBC California:**

USGBC-CA is about people – Passionate, practical, and informed professionals and advocates who work together to transform California into a more sustainable region for all. USGBC-CA is the best place for anyone to learn the “why”, “who” and “how” of living sustainably, because business, as usual, is no longer an option. Volunteers and members believe in a sustainable built environment, gaining education, being exposed to innovation, and taking impactful action.

jobs.description:
***Why Axcel Learning?***

At Axcel Learning, we offer the best of both worlds: the entrepreneurial spirit and agility of a start-up, backed by the stability and resources of a larger portfolio backed by a PE firm. We’re building something meaningful, helping people gain the skills and training they need to advance their careers. Every team member plays a direct role in that mission. We prioritize honesty, respect, and putting learners first. You’ll find room to run, opportunities to grow, and a high-energy team that’s as motivated by outcomes as it is by having fun along the way.

**The Impact You’ll Make**

We’re looking for a hands-on marketer to own organic social media and community events for our Healthcare vertical. You’ll work across two brands: HealthStaff Training Institute (HSTI), which prepares students for careers in healthcare, and KMK Optometry, which prepares optometry students for their board exams. Sitting on the Marketing team, you’ll set the social strategy for both brands and create the content yourself.

You’ll also be the in-person face of our Healthcare brands in Los Angeles. You’ll plan and run the events where we meet prospective students, schools, employers, and workforce partners, then turn what happens there into leads and content.

**What You’ll Own**

**Organic Social Strategy & Content Calendar**

* Set the organic social strategy for HSTI and KMK, including channel priorities, content themes, posting cadence, and goals for each brand
* Own the content calendar for both brands, timed to enrollment periods, exam cycles, campus milestones, and the broader marketing calendar
* Create and publish posts, short-form video, reels, and graphics across Instagram, Facebook and TikTok
* Manage community engagement: respond to comments and messages, clear spam, and route prospective-student inquiries to Admissions
* Grow student and graduate reviews for both brands: monitor review sites, coordinate outreach with campus staff, and respond professionally to public reviews
* Track performance, report results monthly, and refresh content when it starts to fatigue
* Keep every post consistent with each brand’s look, voice, and standards

**Content Capture**

* Coordinate photo and video shoots at campuses and events, and gather student testimonials, success stories, and milestone moments
* Maintain an organized library of reusable assets along with the photo and video releases that go with them

**Community Events & Brand Representation**

* Build and manage the HSTi events calendar: career fairs, community and workforce events
* Represent HSTI in person: staff booths, present our programs, and build relationships with prospective students, schools, employers, and workforce partners, turning in person interactions into actionable leads
* Run event logistics end to end, including registrations, booth materials, signage, giveaways, invitations, and follow-up
* Coordinate with printers and promotional-item vendors, gather quotes, place approved orders, and manage giveaway inventory
* Capture leads at every event and hand them to Admissions or the right partner contact for follow-up
* Report on each event’s attendance, leads, and cost, and recommend which events earn a spot on next year’s calendar
* Keep Admissions, instructors, and campus leaders informed of upcoming events and social campaigns

**Qualifications & Skills**

* 3-5 years in social media, community, or event marketing, with ownership of both strategy and hands-on execution
* A track record of running organic social for a brand, including managing a content calendar and growing engagement
* Strong content creation skills: writing, Canva design, and shooting and editing short-form video
* Experience planning and executing in-person events, and confidence representing a brand face to face
* Comfort with social analytics and turning results into clear next steps
* Strong organization; you can run two brands’ calendars and a full events schedule without dropping details
* Experience with social scheduling tools or a CRM is a plus
* Experience in education, healthcare, or career training is a plus
* Based in the Los Angeles area, with reliable transportation and availability for some evening and weekend events
* A portfolio of social content and event work to share during the interview process
* Scrappy, self-starting, entrepreneurial mindset, comfortable building from the ground up and wearing many hats

**Why You’ll Love It Here**

* **Mission with Meaning –** Your work empowers learners to achieve real career outcomes.
* **Room to Run –** Operate with startup agility, backed by long-term investor support.
* **Ownership Mentality –** Build and lead a high-impact function from day one with autonomy and visibility.
* **Collaborative Culture –** You’ll be part of a passionate, fun, and high-performing team that values doing good work and enjoying the process.

Pay: $72,000.00 - $78,000.00 per year

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Los Angeles, CA 90041

Pay range: $38.19 - $61.45 an hour

The Services and Support Operations (SSO) is a global leader of integrated MRO services and support. We are proud to serve airlines/ business jet operators, the military, airframe/ engine manufacturers, as well as independent service centers. Manages and executes all sales activities and contracted bookings for Premier and Strategic customer accounts. Partners with internal SSO and division teams to improve customer scorecard performance and increase LTR. Identifies growth opportunities across major programs, product lines, and market segments within the division, while supporting the execution of awarded business negotiated by Business Development Managers within the territory. Performs root cause analysis for underperforming spare parts and MRO components and develops, coordinates, and implements corrective action plans to improve performance.

\_\_\_\_ Has Direct Reports \_\_X\_\_ Does Not Have Direct Reports

jobs.title: Business Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
The rapidly growing **Dale E. and Sarah Ann Fowler School of Engineering** (FSE) seeks highly motivated colleagues to help build Chapman University’s newest school. Opened in the Fall of 2019, FSE offers undergraduate degree programs in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Data Science, Software Engineering, and Electrical Engineering, along with a new graduate program, a MS in Electrical Engineering and Computer Science. The School also offers several interdisciplinary minors and themed programs which allow students from across other Chapman programs to explore engineering. FSE is housed in the new **Swenson Family Hall of Engineering**, a cutting-edge facility that supports student learning, campus-wide project activities, and faculty-led research.  
  
Under the direction of the Director of Operations, the Fowler School of Engineering (FSE) Business Operations Specialist provides comprehensive management of the School’s financial and business operations. The position is responsible for ensuring the accuracy, integrity, compliance, and effective administration of FSE’s financial activities, budgets, employment processes, and business transactions. The Business Operations Specialist serves as a liaison between FSE and the University’s administrative, financial, human resources, research, payroll, and other departments, representing the School and facilitating the timely resolution of financial and operational matters.  
  
This position requires accountability, initiative in managing multiple priorities, the ability to implement business processes, and coordination of financial and employment transactions and analyses. Success in this role requires exceptional attention to detail, sound judgment, discretion, initiative, strong organizational and project management abilities, and the capacity to work independently while building effective partnerships across the University and within a collaborative team environment. The Business Operations Specialist may lead or participate in School and University committees, cross-functional initiatives, and special projects, and may provide guidance, training, and direction to FSE staff, faculty and students on financial and business processes. Other duties as assigned.

Responsibilities

**Financial Operations**  
  
In collaboration with the Director of Operations, responsible for the day-to-day financial operations of the School. This includes, but is not limited to:

* Manage the school’s financial processes, improve accountability, control expenses, and monitor financial activity.
* Generate biweekly, monthly, and annual reports, reporting potential variances, and ensure budget targets are met.
* Serve as a liaison to Offices of Financial Services, Academic Financial Operations, Payroll, Financial Aid, Purchasing, University Advancement, and Sponsored Projects.
* Review and monitor all financial transactions, including purchase orders, expense reimbursements, purchasing card activities, payroll, service agreements, contracts, and payments to ensure compliance with University Fiscal Policy and funding agency guidelines.
* Assist in the development and management of annual operating budgets, assessing monthly and yearly budgetary needs.
* Provide consultation and support on budget management, enhancement requests, fund allocation, analyze trends, and recommendations on prioritizing needs and resources.
* Oversee faculty and student travel and research allowances, start-up packages, gifts, and awards. Notify recipients of allocations, balances, and advise on appropriate use of funds.
* Provide regular training and communications to staff, faculty, and student workers regarding financial and business policies, procedures, and deadlines. Guide, train and monitor staff and faculty use of PeopleSoft Finance, Concur, PeopleAdmin, and shared systems to manage purchasing, personnel, and financial processes.
* Guide the development liaison and Dean in creating annual endowment and gift reports, donor acknowledgments, gift agreements, and tracking the use of funds.
* Initiates communications with faculty/principal investigators regarding grant finances and pending activities. Collaborate with the Director, the Office of Sponsored Projects, and various departments to resolve discrepancies.
  

**Academic Personnel Support**

* Serve as a liaison to the Offices of Human Resources, Faculty Affairs, Payroll, and various University departments to support hiring and employment-related transactions for faculty, researchers, postdocs, staff, and students.
* Oversee, record and track full-time faculty, postdocs, student worker, and research personnel files from initiating the hiring process to employment renewals and separation.
* Maintain the privacy and confidentiality of all personnel files.

**Other Duties**

* Consult and collaborate on organizational operations and other strategic planning initiatives.
* Provide subject matter expertise to the Director, Dean, and Leadership.
* As part of the Fowler Engineering Team, serve on committees, provide service to the School and University, serve as backup support, and perform other activities as assigned.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree (preferably accounting, finance or business) or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Minimum four years of professional budgetary, administrative, accounting, and fiscal reconciliation experience.
* Experience in interpretation, application and compliance with financial policies and regulations.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills to convey accurate information in a professional and tactful manner, and the ability to interact with a diverse group of individuals at all organizational levels. Ability to maintain a high level of confidentiality is a must.
* PC proficiency is required. An advanced understanding of Microsoft Office programs including the importance of using Excel for financial and business operations.
* Technical skills to learn

jobs.title: [MARKETING] Digital Marketing Manager, Brand Experience and Demand Generation
jobs.description:
**Position Summary:**
---------------------

The Digital Marketing Manager (Brand Experience & Demand Generation) plays a critical role at the intersection of Brand, Media, and Digital Commerce. This position is responsible for driving high-quality consumer demand and shaping the digital brand experience across key touchpoints, ensuring that awareness and consideration efforts translate into measurable business impact.

Acting as a strategic bridge between Brand Marketing, eCommerce, and Media teams, this role focuses on building and activating upper- and mid-funnel strategies that generate qualified traffic and accelerate the path to purchase. The position owns paid media strategy, website experience (TCL.com), and CRM-driven lifecycle marketing to ensure a cohesive and effective consumer journey from discovery through purchase intent.

The successful candidate brings a strong understanding of how modern digital marketing ecosystems operate, with the ability to translate brand and commercial objectives into integrated campaigns, content strategies, and data-driven optimizations that deliver results.

This role is ideal for a marketing professional who is equally comfortable managing media investments and performance metrics as they are shaping digital experiences, content strategies, and consumer journeys.

**Duties & Responsibilities:**
------------------------------

**Paid Media Strategy & Demand Generation**

* Develop and execute upper- and mid-funnel paid media strategies across Video, Social, Display, and Native channels to drive qualified traffic and build consumer consideration.
* Design and implement innovative media approaches that shorten the path from product discovery to purchase, accelerating the "see-to-buy" cycle.
* Build and refine audience segmentation strategies to effectively engage consumers early in the decision-making process and nurture future conversion.
* Own media execution, including budget allocation, performance optimization, and traffic quality, ensuring efficient use of investment aligned with business priorities.

**Website Experience & Content Strategy (TCL.com)**

* Own TCL.com as the central hub for brand storytelling, product education, and consumer engagement-not just as a transactional platform.
* Design and optimize end-to-end user journeys that drive engagement and increase purchase intent through intuitive navigation and compelling content.
* Lead SEO and organic growth initiatives by improving site structure and developing high-quality content (e.g., product pages, guides, editorial content) aligned with consumer research behavior.
* Implement traffic routing strategies that align with business goals, optimizing pathways to retail partners or direct purchase flows as needed.

**CRM & Lifecycle Marketing**

* Develop and manage CRM and email marketing strategies to capture and nurture upper-funnel demand into qualified purchase intent.
* Drive first-party data acquisition through targeted campaigns and on-site lead capture strategies, strengthening direct consumer engagement channels.
* Optimize lifecycle communications to improve engagement, retention, and readiness to convert.

**Analytics, Insights & Performance Optimization**

* Analyze performance across channels with a holistic view, focusing on traffic quality, engagement, and contribution to downstream conversion-not just last-click sales.
* Develop and refine attribution approaches to better understand the impact of upper- and mid-funnel efforts on total business performance (DTC and retail).
* Translate data insights into actionable recommendations to continuously optimize media mix, content strategy, and user experience.

**Business Impact & KPI Ownership**

* Define and track key performance indicators including traffic growth, engagement, SEO visibility, media efficiency, and CRM database expansion.
* Drive measurable improvements in qualified traffic, purchase intent signals, and marketing efficiency through disciplined execution and optimization.
* Promote a data-driven, test-and-learn culture to continuously refine strategies and maximize return on marketing investment.

These duties are directly related to essential operations, safety, trust, and compliance obligations within our organization. Please note that job duties may evolve based on business needs and additional responsibilities may be assigned as necessary to maintain operational efficiency and security.

**Physical and Work Environment Requirements:**
-----------------------------------------------

* This is an on-site position based in Irvine, CA. Regular in-person attendance is an essential function of the role.
* Frequent use of typical office equipments such as keyboard, screens, and monitors. Extended periods of sitting, standing, and moving around the office.
* Occasional travel may be required to support business needs.

**Qualifications:**
-------------------

**Must Have:**

* 5–10 years of experience in digital marketing, paid media, demand generation, or related roles.
* Proven ability to manage and optimize multi-channel paid media campaigns with a focus on upper- and mid-funnel performance.
* Strong understanding of digital consumer journeys, including content strategy, SEO, and lifecycle marketing.
* Hands-on experience with analytics tools and the ability to translate data into actionable insights and business recommendations.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to collaborate across brand, eCommerce, and analytics teams.

**Nice to Have:**

* Experience managing or optimizing brand websites and content hubs.
* Familiarity with CRM platforms and email marketing tools.
* Exposure to multi-channel retail environments (DTC + retail partners).
* Strong analytical mindset with experience in attribution modeling or marketing mix analysis.
* Background in consumer electronics, retail, or high-consideration purchase categories.

**Benefits:**
-------------

* Vacation: Starting at 5 days per year

jobs.title: Production Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Us**  
At Vector Media, we’re building the future of Mobility Marketing, where media moves with people, meets them in real life, and makes a lasting impression.  
  
In an advertising world cluttered with screens and scrolls, we deliver real-world media with real results. From digital bus shelters and street-level storytelling to experiential activations, college campus and sports partnerships, we connect brands with audiences in the moments that matter most.  
  
Our high-impact media, including fully wrapped vehicles and custom-built experiential assets, turns heads in cities nationwide. And with a presence in 50+ markets, we bring campaigns to life across communities, cultures, and coasts.  
  
Founded in 1998, Vector has grown from an OOH disruptor into a full-service platform built on data, creativity, and movement. We call it Marketing in Motion, an approach that blends storytelling and strategy to drive results across every channel we touch.  
  
But what truly sets us apart is how we show up: as partners. With our clients. With our media partners. With each other. Through accountability, innovation, and shared ambition, we’re helping brands do more than reach people, we’re helping them move people.  
  
**What We Value**

* **Accountability:** Taking ownership of our actions, learning from mistakes, and earning trust through responsibility.
* **Growth:** Supporting personal and professional development, knowing that when our team members thrive, the company thrives.
* **Excellence:** Always striving for the best possible results and never settling for “good enough”.
* **Fun:** Bringing energy, creativity, and joy into our work while celebrating our successes together.

**Position Summary**  
Vector Media is searching for a Production Coordinator in Orange County, CA to join our Operations Department. The Production Coordinator will report to the Production Manager. This position is responsible for overseeing assigned campaigns from production kickoff through installation, closeout, and final file archiving, coordinating closely with vendors, printers, fabricators, installers, and internal teams to ensure accurate, on-time delivery of large-format and transit production materials. This position is hybrid, requiring at least 1 day in the office per week.  
  
**What You Are:**

* Strong attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy, quality, and complete documentation.
* Demonstrated ownership and accountability; able to move work forward independently while seeking direction when appropriate.
* Sound judgment about when to resolve an issue, ask a question, or escalate a concern.
* A sense of urgency balanced with thoughtful decision-making and respect for established approval processes.
* A collaborative, customer-focused approach and the professionalism to navigate challenging or ambiguous situations.
* Adaptability, curiosity, and a willingness to learn new systems, materials, formats, and market requirements.

**What You’ll Bring:**

* Exceptional organization, time management, and follow-through, with the ability to manage a high volume of detailed work.
* Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills, including the ability to consider timing, cost, quality, risk, and priority when evaluating options.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to tailor information to clients, vendors, peers, and leadership.

**What You’ll Do:**

* Own assigned campaigns from production kickoff through installation, closeout, and final file archiving.
* Build and manage production schedules based on artwork deadlines, print lead times, shipping requirements, installation dates, and campaign priorities.
* Review incoming artwork, specifications, quantities, and production instructions for completeness and compliance with large-format and transit production requirements.
* Coordinate proofing and approval workflows; carefully review proofs, revisions, dimensions, materials, finishing details, color expectations, and final quantities before authorizing production.
* Translate production requirements into clear guidance for Sales, clients, agencies, and creative teams, and obtain missing information before deadlines are at risk.
* Prepare accurate vendor orders and purchase orders, confirm scope and pricing, and flag discrepancies, added costs, or scope changes before work proceeds.
* Partner with printers, fabricators, installers, media partners, and internal teams to confirm feasibility, timelines, delivery details, and installation readiness.

jobs.description:
**“See It and Be It” Program Coordinator (Richmond Area)**

**STEAM the Streets | Part-Time Contract | 8-15 hours/week | November–March | $30/hour**

**About STEAM the Streets**

STEAM the Streets is a mission-driven organization that uses media, music, arts, and STEAM education to connect young people to careers and inspire them to see new possibilities for their futures.

**About the Role**

STEAM the Streets is seeking a highly organized, proactive **See It and Be It Richmond Area Program Coordinator** to support the delivery of our **See It and Be It** program with our partners at West Contra Costa Unified School District (WCCUSD) Department of College and Career.

This is a **part-time, project-based contract role** responsible for coordinating logistics, communication, and school-site readiness across four participating middle schools. The coordinator will help ensure that the program is organized and ready from initial school coordination through the February assembly week and early curriculum implementation.

The ideal candidate is organized, responsive, comfortable communicating with school staff, and able to manage multiple moving pieces with minimal supervision.

**About the See It and Be It Program**

**See It and Be It** is a career exploration program from STEAM the Streets that introduces middle school students to a range of STEAM careers through engaging classroom curriculum and real-world exposure. The program kicks off with our **“This Can Be You”** career exploration assemblies, followed by classroom-based career exploration that helps students discover new possibilities and pathways for their future.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Program Preparation & Coordination – November–January**

* Onboard with STEAM the Streets and review existing commitments, timelines, contacts, forms, and planning materials for the four participating schools.
* Establish and maintain communication with school administrators and teachers at each site.
* Schedule planning meetings and coordinate follow-up with each school.
* Coordinate deadlines and readiness activities leading up to the February assemblies.
* Ensure January deadlines are met for assembly forms, school site visits, technical checks, schedules, and final confirmations.
* Conduct site visits to assess assembly spaces and document logistics, including room setup, AV/technical needs, parking/loading, student capacity, and arrival procedures.
* Coordinate technical checks and communicate site-specific needs to the STEAM the Streets team.
* Maintain a master schedule and program logistics tracker for all four schools.
* Coordinate catering and materials for the professional development/training session.
* Support preparation and on-site logistics for the December train-the-trainer session for approximately 8–12 WCCUSD educators.
* Coordinate pre-program survey follow-up with participating teachers, ensuring teachers understand their role in distributing and completing student pre-surveys.

**This Can Be You Assembly Week – February 8-12**The coordinator will serve as the primary on-the-ground logistics support for STEAM the Streets during assembly week, ensuring each school is prepared and the team has what it needs to successfully deliver the assemblies.

Responsibilities include:

* Confirm final details with each school prior to arrival.
* Coordinate arrival times and access with school staff and the STEAM the Streets team.
* Ensure spaces, equipment, materials, and other site requirements are ready before each assembly.
* Help coordinate setup and troubleshoot logistical or technical issues that arise.
* Serve as the on-site point person for school logistics and communicate issues to the Founder / CEO as needed.
* Assist with breakdown and ensure materials and equipment are accounted for following each assembly.
* Complete daily follow-up and flag any outstanding issues or changes.

**Program Implementation – March**

* Maintain light-touch communication with participating educators as curriculum implementation begins.
* Follow up with teachers regarding student surveys and other program information.
* Conduct occasional school-site check-ins as needed.
* Track questions, issues, and follow-up items and escalate anything requiring STEAM the Streets leadership.
* Assist with collecting program feedback and basic participation information.

**Ideal Candidate**

* Highly organized and detail-oriented.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Comfortable communicating with school administrators, teachers, and education professionals.
* Reliable, responsive, and able to manage deadlines independently.
* Comfortable working on-site at schools and during program events.
* Able to anticipate logistical needs and troubleshoot problems calmly.
* Experience in education, youth programs, events, or nonprofit program coordination is a plus.
* Familiarity with WCCUSD or Richmond-area schools is helpful but not required.

**Contract Details**

**Position:** See It and Be It Richmond Area Program Coordinator**Type:** Part-Time Contract**Term:** November–March**Hours:** 8–15 hours per week, with a spike in hours during the February 8–12 assembly week**Rate:** $30/hour**Location:** Richmond area / Hybrid, with required in-person work at district and school sites during program activities**Reports to:** Founder / CEO, STEAM the Streets

**What Success Looks Like**

The coordinator keeps the **See It and Be It** program moving and makes sure each school is prepared, informed, and ready. By the time the STEAM the Streets team arrives at a school, the logistics should be confirmed, the site should be ready, and any potential issues should already be identified and communicated.

**Success means:**

* Each school is informed, prepared, and ready for its scheduled program activities.
* Assembly logistics are confirmed in advance, potential issues are identified early, and each assembly runs smoothly from arrival through breakdown.

jobs.title: Inclusion Concierge Program Specialist (Circles of Support & Disability Services)
jobs.description:
**About the Role**

This position is grant-funded for an initial 18-month term. The Kelsey may seek continued funding for the position, but employment beyond 18 months is not guaranteed.

The Inclusion Concierge Program Specialist brings specialized disability expertise to The Kelsey’s Resident Services program, grounded in experience supporting adults with a range of disabilities and support needs, including people with intellectual and developmental disabilities (IDD). A primary focus of this role is launching and strengthening The Kelsey’s Circles of Support practice for residents with higher or more complex support needs, co-facilitating Circles alongside Inclusion Concierge to strengthen residents’ natural and formal supports while centering their goals, choices, and self-determination.

The Program Specialist also serves as a disability services and benefits resource for residents and the Inclusion Concierge team, bringing deeper knowledge of disability systems, benefits, services, and community resources when more specialized support is needed. They will help strengthen disability-forward practice across Resident Services by sharing their expertise and developing practical tools, resources, and training that support current Inclusion Concierges and can be carried forward as The Kelsey opens new communities.

For this role, you will:

**Launch & Co-Facilitate Circles of Support**

* Lead the implementation and ongoing development of The Kelsey’s Circles of Support practice, incorporating input from residents and people with lived experience of disability, with a focus on residents with higher or more complex support needs.
* Partner with Inclusion Concierge to identify residents who may benefit from a facilitated Circle of Support and co-facilitate the process alongside the resident’s IC.
* Help residents identify, build, and strengthen their Circle of Support, including family, friends, neighbors, community connections, service providers, and others the resident chooses to involve.
* Facilitate accessible, resident-directed Circle conversations that keep the resident’s goals, preferences, communication needs, choices, and self-determination at the center while helping their network strengthen communication and work toward resident-identified goals
* Use Circles proactively to identify gaps in support, strengthen natural supports that complement formal and paid services, reduce isolation, foster interdependence, and build stronger networks that contribute to residents’ well-being and housing stability.
* Develop practical tools and processes for documenting, revisiting, and strengthening Circles so the practice can be sustained and expanded across current and future Kelsey communities.

**Provide Disability-Forward Expertise & Specialized Support**

* Bring specialized knowledge and experience in disability-forward support, with particular expertise in supporting adults with intellectual and developmental disabilities (IDD).
* Work alongside residents and their Inclusion Concierge when more specialized disability expertise would strengthen support, while the IC remains the resident’s primary Resident Services contact.
* Bring person-centered and disability-forward practices—including self-determination, supported decision-making, dignity of risk, natural supports, and interdependence—to resident support and planning.
* Help residents and ICs navigate more complex support needs, including identifying gaps in existing supports and exploring additional formal or natural supports that align with the resident’s goals and preferences.
* Participate in resident case conferences and other collaborative planning as needed, bringing disability-specific knowledge and helping identify when needs are best addressed by outside providers or services.

**Strengthen Benefits & Disability Systems Navigation**

* Maintain strong, current knowledge of benefits, services, and systems available to adults with disabilities locally, regionally, statewide, and federally, including Regional Center services, IHSS, SSI/SSDI, Medi-Cal and Medicare, HCBS, transportation, employment supports, and other disability-specific resources.
* Help residents understand and navigate benefits and services they may be eligible for, particularly when needs are complex, services are interrupted, or additional support is needed beyond a routine referral.
* Serve as a resource to Inclusion Concierge when deeper systems knowledge is needed, helping identify additional options and pathways while ICs continue to make referrals and maintain ongoing relationships with residents and their service partners.
* Build relationships with disability organizations, public agencies, Regional Centers, benefits resources, service providers, and other community partners to stay connected to available resources and emerging opportunities for residents.
* Develop and maintain practical benefits and resource information that can be used by residents and Inclusion Concierge across The Kelsey’s communities.

**Strengthen & Share Disability-Forward Inclusion Concierge Practice**

* Translate lessons from Circles of Support, disability services navigation, and direct resident work into practical tools and resources that strengthen The Kelsey’s Resident Services program, including a clear, replicable framework that other inclusive communities can adapt.
* Support recruitment, training, and retention of volunteers who support Resident Services programming and residents across The Kelsey’s communities, building a pipeline for future growth.
* Partner with Resident Services leadership to identify opportunities to deepen disability-forward practices and incorporate effective approaches into the broader Inclusion Concierge model.
* Develop and support training for current and new Inclusion Concierges on Circles of Support, disability services and systems, person-centered support, and other disability-forward practices.
* Provide backup Inclusion Concierge s

**General Summary:**

Job Overview

At Qualcomm, the Technical Account Manager (TAM) is responsible for overseeing the customer’s product portfolio and managing the technical aspects of Qualcomm hardware and software components designed into customer projects. As a Staff Technical Account Manager focused on Industrial & Enterprise IoT (IE‑IoT), you will work closely with customers building connected, intelligent systems across industries such as industrial automation, smart infrastructure, edge computing, retail, and enterprise solutions. This role serves as the primary technical interface between customers and Qualcomm’s internal engineering, product, and business teams, ensuring successful project execution from early evaluation through commercialization and deployment.

  
  

Key Responsibilities

You will be required to:

Technical Customer Ownership: Support the Sales Account Manager by leading and managing technical relationships between IE‑IoT customers and Qualcomm business units. Act as the primary technical point of contact for customer engagements.

  
  

Project & Execution Management: Provide overall project management for customer programs from concept, evaluation, and design-in through production and deployment. Align customer milestones with Qualcomm hardware and software delivery timelines in collaboration with product management and program management teams.

  
  

Issue Resolution & Escalation Management: For projects under development, drive customer issues to resolution by working closely with engineering teams. Mitigate risks and support escalations while setting clear and realistic technical expectations with customers.

  
  

Customer Evaluation & Enablement: For projects under evaluation, engage customers by organizing technical trainings, design reviews, and architecture discussions. Gather customer requirements, analyze technical gaps, and assess risks related to commercialization in IE‑IoT use cases.

  
  

Cross‑Functional Collaboration: Collaborate daily with internal engineering, product, software, and systems teams to support customer success. Effectively translate customer use cases and requirements into actionable feedback for internal teams.

jobs.title: Manager, Technical Account Management
jobs.description:
**About the Role**
------------------

Cyberhaven is looking for a Manager, Technical Account Management to build and lead the team of Technical Account Managers who own the technical relationship with our customers. Your team is accountable for how each customer deploys, adopts, and gets value from Cyberhaven's Agentic Data Security platform, from onboarding through renewal. You will hire and develop the team, define how TAMs work with accounts, and make sure customers get a consistent, proactive technical partner and experience.

You are a people leader with a technical background in security SaaS and endpoint agents, and you are comfortable in a fast-paced, high-growth environment where the team's processes are still being written. You will coach TAMs on and step in on critical escalations when needed. You will also work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Support Engineering, Customer Experience, and Sales to turn what the team learns from customers into improvements to the product and to how we serve customers.

Technical depth, a strong client focus, and experience leading customer-facing technical teams are required. You will report to the VP of Support and Technical Account Management.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

### **Lead and grow the team**

* Hire, onboard, and develop Technical Account Managers. Set clear expectations, give regular feedback, and run career development and performance reviews.
* Coach TAMs on account strategy, technical troubleshooting, executive communication, and managing difficult customer situations.
* Build a team culture of growth mindset, ownership, curiosity, and accountability for customer outcomes.
* Plan headcount and coverage as the customer base grows, including how accounts are assigned and balanced across the team.

### **Define how the TAM function operates**

* Establish the TAM operating model: account segmentation, coverage, engagement cadence, business review format, and technical success plans.
* Set the team's goals and metrics, such as account health, agent coverage and deployment progress, adoption, escalation volume and time to resolution, and customer satisfaction. Report on them to leadership.
* Create and maintain playbooks, runbooks, and knowledge base standards so TAMs handle common situations the same way.
* Define the handoffs between TAMs and Customer Experience and Sales so customers always know who owns what.

### **Own customer outcomes**

* Review account health across the team's book of business and step in early on accounts at risk of low adoption, deployment problems, or churn.
* Act as the senior escalation point for critical customer issues. Make sure TAMs bring clear reproductions and context to Engineering, and that customers stay informed through resolution.
* Build relationships with customes, and join executive and business reviews for strategic accounts.
* Work with Customer Success and Sales on renewals, expansions, and risk mitigation, providing technical input and account insight.

### **Be the voice of the customer**

* Collect customer feedback, feature requests, and recurring issues from the team and bring them to Product Management and Engineering with the technical and business context behind them.
* Work with Engineering and Support Engineering to improve diagnostics, debugging tools, and escalation processes.
* Run root cause analysis reviews on significant incidents and drive preventive follow-ups so issues do not repeat.
* Stay current on industry trends, security best practices, and adjacent technologies such as SIEM, SOAR, and UEBA, and bring them into the team's guidance to customers.

**Who You Are**
---------------

* 3+ years of experience managing a team of Technical Account Managers, Support Engineers, Solutions Engineers, or similar customer-facing technical staff.
* 7+ years in customer-facing technical roles.
* Track record of hiring, developing, and retaining strong technical people, and of handling performance issues directly and fairly.
* Experience building or scaling a TAM, Support, or Customer Success function, including processes, playbooks, and metrics.
* Demonstrated ability to own customer technical outcomes from implementation through steady-state operation, and to understand a customer's architecture and environment end-to-end.
* Hands-on experience deploying, supporting, and troubleshooting SaaS-based security and/or endpoint agent technologies.
* Proven experience managing escalated technical customer issues and working directly with engineering teams.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills (English), including the ability to engage both hands-on practitioners and executive stakeholders.
* Strong organizational and planning skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, set timelines, and track progress across a team and its accounts.
* Practical knowledge of networking, security products, enterprise network infrastructure, and Windows, macOS, and Linux endpoint management (SCCM, GPO, Intune, MDM, and application management).
* Ability to read and interpret logs and diagnostic output across Windows, macOS, Linux, and Google Kubernetes Engine well enough to coach others and guide technical investigations.

### **Desired**

* Familiarity with adjacent technologies that Cyberhaven integrates with (SIEM, SOAR, UEBA).
* Expertise with DLP, Insider Threat, and CASB solutions.
* Prior experience leading a TAM team at a security or SaaS company.
* Experience working in an early-stage or high-growth company where the team's processes were still being defined.
* Background in L2/L3 or Escalation Engineering for EDR or DLP tools.

Joining Cyberhaven means joining the team building Data Security for the Agentic Enterprise. Traditional tools fall short. Cyberhaven traces the full lifecycle of your data, adapting protection to changing context, so protection moves with the way people actually work, not against it. AI Changed Work. We Protect It.

**Why You'll Love Working at Gothic**

* Healthcare benefits
* 401(k) with company match

* **Company-paid take-home vehicle**
* Company-paid cell phone and laptop

* Career advancement opportunities
* A fast-paced, team-oriented environment
* A culture that fosters growth, inspires longevity, and rewards mutual loyalty

If you're ready to take the next step in your career and make an impact with a company that values **people, relationships, accountability, and growth**, we want to hear from you.

**The only thing missing is YOU. Apply Today!**

**Account Manager – Client Partnerships & Liquidity Solutions**

**Location:** San Francisco, California 94102 (Downtown / Financial District)  
**Position Type:** Full-time, permanent, benefits-eligible (at-will employment)  
**Work Arrangement:** Hybrid – flexible mix of in-office and remote work  
**Compensation:** $6,500 – $8,700 gross per month (approximately $78,000 – $104,400 annually) + annual performance-based bonus (up to 15%)  
**Work Authorization:** Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States without requiring sponsorship

**Why This Role Stands Out**

This is not a typical account management position. You will be joining a specialized consulting firm where liquidity management, treasury advisory, and working capital optimization are the core of what we do. Our San Francisco office serves a sophisticated client base — industrial corporations, financial institutions, and investment funds — and we need someone who can grow into a trusted partner for those clients.

You will report to a Senior Account Manager and work alongside teams in Financial Consulting, Treasury Advisory, Compliance, Data Analytics, and Customer Success. Support the Senior Account Manager in overseeing a portfolio of domestic and international clients. Manage operational tasks, administrative workflows, and routine reporting to keep accounts running efficiently.

Serve as the first point of contact for client inquiries regarding liquidity management services — cash forecasting, working capital optimization, cash flow management, and treasury operations. Ensure every response is timely, professional, and accurate.

**Consulting Project Support**  
Collaborate with senior consultants to gather and analyze client financial data. Assist with preparing reports, executive presentations, and commercial proposals. Track project milestones and flag issues that need escalation.

**Technical Competencies**

* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel for financial data analysis and reporting.

jobs.title: Strategic Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**Hi, We're AppFolio**
----------------------

We're innovators, changemakers, and collaborators. We're more than a software company. We're pioneers in cloud and AI who deliver magical experiences that make our customers' lives easier. We're revolutionizing how people do business in the real estate industry, and we want your ideas, enthusiasm, and passion to help us keep innovating.

**About the Role**
------------------

As a **Strategic Customer Success Manager (SCSM)** in AppFolio's Revenue Organization, you'll own the success of a portfolio of our largest, most valuable accounts. You'll be the trusted advisor to sophisticated operators. You'll build relationships at every level, from owners and VPs to day-to-day teams. You'll use your industry knowledge to help customers get measurable results from the AppFolio Real Estate Performance Management (RPM) platform.

You'll bring the right resources in at the right moment in the customer journey so customers reach their evolving business goals. You'll partner closely with a Technical Account Manager (TAM) and the rest of your account pod to design solutions around each customer's challenges.

**Your Impact**
---------------

### **Retention and risk mitigation**

* Protect and grow long-term revenue by positioning AppFolio as a strategic partner and showing continuous, measurable platform ROI.
* Spot churn signals early through health-score monitoring, then run data-driven plans to protect at-risk revenue.
* Forecast renewals and analyze past churn to sharpen your account-health strategy.

### **Adoption and usage**

* Educate customers on underused features and best practices that fit their business model.
* Use platform usage data to find gaps and deliver targeted training to key stakeholders.
* Map platform capabilities to customer workflows so they get full value against their goals.

### **Growth and expansion**

* Identify and qualify expansion opportunities, including add-on products and service-tier upgrades.
* Pass insights and qualified leads from your customer relationships to Sales and Growth teams.
* Map white space within existing accounts to uncover new revenue potential.

### **Stakeholder relationships and success planning**

* Build strong relationships with senior decision-makers (VPs, Directors, Owners) across your portfolio.
* Translate customer business goals into technology-driven strategies on the AppFolio platform.
* Create and own Joint Success Plans that tie AppFolio adoption to goals like increasing NOI or reducing operational overhead.
* Lead Business Reviews (QBRs/EBRs) focused on ROI, value realized, and progress toward goals.
* Support executive-alignment efforts on your most strategic accounts with senior CSMs and leadership.

### **Renewal and lifecycle management**

* Recommend subscription tiers (Core, Plus, Max) that match each customer's unit-growth path.
* Manage renewal timing and lifecycle milestones across your portfolio.
* Find and nurture reference customers for testimonials and case studies, working with Marketing and Sales.

### **Cross-functional collaboration**

* Partner with TAMs to design and implement solutions for specific client challenges.
* Advocate for customers by relaying product feedback to the right teams and helping shape roadmap priorities.
* Work with your account pod (GAEs, TAMs, Product Managers) to coordinate delivery and value.
* Stay current on industry trends and the AppFolio platform, and add to the team's knowledge base.

**How We Define Success**
-------------------------

* Strong gross and net revenue retention across your Strategic portfolio
* Completed Business Reviews and active relationships with key stakeholders

jobs.description:
Our mission is to detect cancer early, when it can be cured. We are working to change the trajectory of cancer mortality and bring stakeholders together to adopt innovative, safe, and effective technologies that can transform cancer care.

We are a healthcare company, pioneering new technologies to advance early cancer detection. We have built a multi-disciplinary organization of scientists, engineers, and physicians and we are using the power of next-generation sequencing (NGS), population-scale clinical studies, and state-of-the-art computer science and data science to overcome one of medicine’s greatest challenges.

GRAIL is headquartered in the Bay Area of California, with locations in Washington, D.C., North Carolina, and the United Kingdom. It is supported by leading global investors and pharmaceutical, technology, and healthcare companies.

For more information, please visit grail.com

GRAIL is seeking a highly motivated, self-starter Enterprise Inside Sales Representative to open doors and build new relationships with self-insured employers, life insurers, payers and first responders in an assigned territory. You will identify companies and contacts for outreach, secure meetings with key decision-makers, and manage a robust pipeline of marketing qualified leads. You will also engage in full sales-cycle management of midmarket deals in partnership with the sales team. This role will work in collaboration with the Employer and Labor Sales and Marketing teams and report to the Sr. Director of Employer and Labor Sales. This role is a great “foot in the door” opportunity for a career in B2B/enterprise sales.

This role is based in Sunnyvale, California. It offers a flexible work arrangement, with the ability to work from GRAIL's office or from home. Our current flexible work arrangement policy requires that a minimum of 60%, or 24 hours, of your total work week be on-site. Your specific schedule, determined in collaboration with your manager, will align with team and business needs and could exceed the 60% requirement for the site. At our Sunnyvale campus, Tuesdays and Thursdays are the key days where we encourage on-site presence to engage in events and on-site activities.

* Work within a commercial vertical (Employer and Labor Union) and a geographic region, to drive interest, leads, and new account opportunities to the sales team and support their broader activities.
* Enter calls, activities and customer information into a CRM (Salesforce)/Outreach and update as needed to keep all stakeholders informed.

* Use sales and marketing automation tools to enhance exposure within target accounts, measure inbound and outbound activities, and monitor effectiveness of personal sales activity.
* Achieve goals for sales activities, including outbound calls made, new prospects identified, meetings scheduled and meetings completed.
* Grow into opportunity management from identification to closure of midmarket deals
* Meet SLA’s and demonstrate diligence in following up on responses from prospects and persistence in making multiple attempts to each prospect for improved response rates.
* Provide market feedback on competitive activity, pricing, and other industry trends to marketing and sales stakeholders.
* Contribute the company culture by embracing and enhancing company values.

*These responsibilities summarize the role’s primary responsibilities and are not an exhaustive list. They may change at the company’s discretion.*

### **Required Qualifications:**

* Minimum 2 years inside sales or field sales experience.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent.
* Travel as necessary (~20%).
* Experience with sales and prospecting tools, such as Salesforce, Outreach, LinkedIn Sales Navigator and Apollo.

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience within pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or lab sales and/or ideally selling into HR & Benefits leaders within self-insured employers, health systems, life insurance and health plan companies.
* Superior verbal and written communication skills.
* Demonstrated experience with identifying and closing sales opportunities.
* Demonstrated ability to communicate complex information into an “elevator pitch” to get someone’s attention and persuade them to take action.

The expected, full-time, hourly pay scale for this position is $35.57-$43.75.
