**WHY JOIN ALO?**

Mindful movement. It's at the core of why we do what we do at ALO—it's our calling. Because mindful movement in the studio leads to better living. It changes who yogis are off the mat, making their lives and their communities better. That's the real meaning of studio-to-street: taking the consciousness from practice on the mat and putting it into practice in life.

**OVERVIEW**

The Construction Program Specialist supports the successful execution of ALO's Store Development projects by coordinating timelines, documentation, and communications across Construction, Store Design, and Real Estate. This role ensures alignment and efficiency throughout the project lifecycle—from site approval through store opening—by managing key systems, maintaining schedules, and fostering collaboration across all functional partners.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

Project Coordination & Scheduling

* Coordinate and track all project milestones, deliverables, and dependencies within the master project schedule (Smartsheet or similar)
* Launch new projects internally upon Real Estate Committee approval, ensuring all required documentation and communication protocols are in place.
* Communicate milestone deadlines and critical path updates to stakeholders across departments.
* Identify potential schedule risks and collaborate with internal teams to develop solutions.
* Coordinate project kickoffs, status updates, and cross-functional meetings; document and distribute meeting notes and action items.

Platform & System Administration

* Serve as primary administrator for Store Development platforms, including Procore, Smartsheet, and shared project databases.
* Manage system setup, project creation, user permissions, and access for internal and external stakeholders.
* Maintain standardized folder structures and ensure ongoing compliance with file management policies.
* Partner with IT and project teams to streamline workflows, integrate data between platforms, and improve reporting accuracy.
* Support ongoing development of dashboards, reports, and templates to enhance visibility and accountability across programs.
* Train and support team members and vendors on platform use and best practices.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

* Facilitate effective communication and coordination across Real Estate, Store Design, Construction, Finance, Facilities, and Operations teams.
* Partner with cross-program leads to align timelines, deliverables, and project dependencies across multiple initiatives (e.g., remodels, pop-ups, relocations).
* Act as a liaison between landlords, vendors, and internal partners to ensure smooth handoffs and clear documentation flow.
* Support the integration of sustainability, technology, and brand standards into all project processes.

Administrative & Operational Support

* Obtain, track, and file critical documents from Real Estate, landlords, and consultants.
* Coordinate utility setups and partner with Accounts Payable to ensure timely account activation and billing accuracy.
* Support vendor onboarding, purchase order tracking, and contract management as needed.
* Maintain confidentiality and professionalism while handling sensitive company and project information.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* 2–4 years of experience in construction, store development, design coordination, or a related field.
* Bachelor's degree preferred.
* Proficiency with Procore, Smartsheet, and Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Project).
* Strong organizational and communication skills, with acute attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Collaborative mindset with a proactive, professional, and solution-oriented approach.

The base salary range for this position is $75,000 - $85,000 per year which represents the current range for the base salary for this exempt position. Please note that actual salaries will vary based on factors including but not limited to location, experience, and performance. As such, on occasion and when applicable, there is the possibility that the final, agreed-upon base salary may be outside of the upper end of the range. Please also note the range listed is just one component of the company's total rewards package for exempt employees. Other rewards may include performance bonuses, long term incentives, a PTO policy, and many other progressive benefits.

new_jobs.title: Real Estate Administrative Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
Join our dynamic real estate team as a dedicated Real Estate Administrative Coordinator, where your organizational prowess and communication skills will drive success in residential property transactions. This vital role offers the opportunity to coordinate seamless real estate operations, support sales initiatives, and foster strong client relationships. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, possess a passion for real estate, and excel at multitasking, this is your chance to make a meaningful impact while growing professionally in a vibrant industry.

**Position Summary**

The Real Estate Administrative Coordinator provides comprehensive administrative and operational support to Apex Realty's leasing, property management, and executive teams. The position is responsible for maintaining accurate property and leasing documentation, coordinating leasing transactions and Letters of Intent (LOIs), supporting lease negotiations and renewals, tracking Property Manager workflows, facilitating tenant transitions, and preparing portfolio-level reports for executive review.

The position also supports broker coordination, vendor administration, and internal operational processes to ensure documentation, deadlines, and required deliverables are completed accurately and efficiently.

Additionally, the role contributes to Apex Realty's continued modernization by researching and utilizing technology, artificial intelligence (AI), digital resources, and process-improvement tools to enhance administrative efficiency and streamline company workflows.

The successful candidate will be highly organized, detail-oriented, technologically proficient, and capable of managing multiple administrative priorities while coordinating with internal departments and external business partners.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Leasing & Transaction Administration**

* Maintain, organize, and update property and leasing documentation within the Apex server and AppFolio, ensuring records are accurate, complete, and readily accessible.
* Coordinate documentation required throughout the Letter of Intent (LOI) process, including tenant financial statements, personal financial statements, business experience, ownership information, and other due-diligence materials.
* Prepare draft leases, offers, counteroffers, lease amendments, extensions, renewal proposals, and related leasing documents for executive and legal review.
* Provide administrative and documentation support throughout lease and lease renewal negotiations.
* Track leasing activity, pending approvals, outstanding documentation, execution status, and transaction deadlines.
* Research and identify prospective commercial real estate brokers and submit recommendations to Executive Leadership.
* Prepare broker listing agreements for review and approval, and maintain broker correspondence, marketing reports, and related documentation.
* Coordinate communications among brokers, tenants, Property Managers, and Executive Leadership regarding leasing transactions.

**2. Property Management Administrative Coordination**

* Provide administrative and workflow support to Property Managers to facilitate timely completion of assigned responsibilities.
* Monitor outstanding action items, deadlines, documentation requirements, and operational deliverables.
* Follow up with Property Managers regarding incomplete documentation, pending assignments, and required updates.
* Maintain tracking systems and administrative records to support operational accountability.
* Identify overdue or unresolved matters and communicate them to the appropriate supervisor or Executive Leadership.
* Assist with the coordination and implementation of established company procedures and administrative workflows.

**3. Tenant Move-In & Move-Out Coordination**

* Coordinate administrative requirements associated with tenant move-ins and move-outs in accordance with company procedures.
* Assist with the preparation, collection, and tracking of tenant documentation.
* Coordinate the Lease Abstract, AppFolio, and Tenant Portal processes to ensure accurate and timely entry of tenant information.
* Communicate with Property Managers, Accounting, and other departments regarding required tenant transition documentation.
* Monitor completion of move-in and move-out administrative requirements and follow up on outstanding items.
* Maintain accurate tenant records and supporting documentation.

**4. Portfolio Reporting & Executive Support**

Prepare, maintain, and present routine portfolio reports to the Executive Vice President, including:

* Property vacancies and current leasing activity.
* Tenant delinquencies and outstanding balances.
* Month-to-month tenants.
* Upcoming lease expirations and renewal opportunities.
* Pending leasing transactions and outstanding documentation.
* Other operational reports requested by Executive Leadership.

Additional responsibilities include:

* Collect and consolidate information from Property Managers, AppFolio, and other company resources.
* Verify report accuracy and maintain consistent reporting formats.
* Identify missing information, approaching deadlines, outstanding action items, and matters requiring executive attention.
* Assist with the preparation of executive presentations, meeting materials, and operational summaries.

**5. Vendor & General Administrative Coordination**

* Prepare, organize, and maintain vendor agreements, contracts, invoices, and supporting documentation.
* Coordinate vendor documentation, invoice submissions, and payment processing with the Accounting Department.
* Follow up with vendors and internal departments regarding outstanding documentation, approvals, and payment status.
* Maintain organized vendor records and related property files.
* Assist with vendor correspondence, contract renewals, and other administrative requirements.
* Provide general administrative support for special projects and operational initiatives as assigned.

This role works alongside the Site Manager (Food Distribution) and program coordinators to help ensure food distributions, volunteer activities, food recovery operations, and community events run efficiently.

This position reports directly to the CEO or Operations Director.

* Provide operational support across Nourish LA's food distribution, food recovery, volunteer, and community engagement programs.
* Assist with preparing supplies, equipment, materials, and work areas for organizational activities and events.
* Support inventory movement, food handling, site logistics, and general operational needs.
* Assist with maintaining organized workspaces, equipment, and program supplies.

**About the Role**
------------------

Cyberhaven is looking for a Manager, Technical Account Management to build and lead the team of Technical Account Managers who own the technical relationship with our customers. Your team is accountable for how each customer deploys, adopts, and gets value from Cyberhaven's Agentic Data Security platform, from onboarding through renewal. You will hire and develop the team, define how TAMs work with accounts, and make sure customers get a consistent, proactive technical partner and experience.

You are a people leader with a technical background in security SaaS and endpoint agents, and you are comfortable in a fast-paced, high-growth environment where the team's processes are still being written. You will coach TAMs on and step in on critical escalations when needed. You will also work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Support Engineering, Customer Experience, and Sales to turn what the team learns from customers into improvements to the product and to how we serve customers.

Technical depth, a strong client focus, and experience leading customer-facing technical teams are required. You will report to the VP of Support and Technical Account Management.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

### **Lead and grow the team**

* Hire, onboard, and develop Technical Account Managers. Set clear expectations, give regular feedback, and run career development and performance reviews.
* Coach TAMs on account strategy, technical troubleshooting, executive communication, and managing difficult customer situations.
* Build a team culture of growth mindset, ownership, curiosity, and accountability for customer outcomes.
* Plan headcount and coverage as the customer base grows, including how accounts are assigned and balanced across the team.

### **Define how the TAM function operates**

* Establish the TAM operating model: account segmentation, coverage, engagement cadence, business review format, and technical success plans.
* Set the team's goals and metrics, such as account health, agent coverage and deployment progress, adoption, escalation volume and time to resolution, and customer satisfaction. Report on them to leadership.
* Create and maintain playbooks, runbooks, and knowledge base standards so TAMs handle common situations the same way.
* Define the handoffs between TAMs and Customer Experience and Sales so customers always know who owns what.

### **Own customer outcomes**

* Review account health across the team's book of business and step in early on accounts at risk of low adoption, deployment problems, or churn.
* Act as the senior escalation point for critical customer issues. Make sure TAMs bring clear reproductions and context to Engineering, and that customers stay informed through resolution.
* Build relationships with customes, and join executive and business reviews for strategic accounts.
* Work with Customer Success and Sales on renewals, expansions, and risk mitigation, providing technical input and account insight.

### **Be the voice of the customer**

* Collect customer feedback, feature requests, and recurring issues from the team and bring them to Product Management and Engineering with the technical and business context behind them.
* Work with Engineering and Support Engineering to improve diagnostics, debugging tools, and escalation processes.
* Run root cause analysis reviews on significant incidents and drive preventive follow-ups so issues do not repeat.
* Stay current on industry trends, security best practices, and adjacent technologies such as SIEM, SOAR, and UEBA, and bring them into the team's guidance to customers.

**Who You Are**
---------------

* 3+ years of experience managing a team of Technical Account Managers, Support Engineers, Solutions Engineers, or similar customer-facing technical staff.
* 7+ years in customer-facing technical roles.
* Track record of hiring, developing, and retaining strong technical people, and of handling performance issues directly and fairly.
* Experience building or scaling a TAM, Support, or Customer Success function, including processes, playbooks, and metrics.
* Demonstrated ability to own customer technical outcomes from implementation through steady-state operation, and to understand a customer's architecture and environment end-to-end.
* Hands-on experience deploying, supporting, and troubleshooting SaaS-based security and/or endpoint agent technologies.
* Proven experience managing escalated technical customer issues and working directly with engineering teams.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills (English), including the ability to engage both hands-on practitioners and executive stakeholders.
* Strong organizational and planning skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, set timelines, and track progress across a team and its accounts.
* Practical knowledge of networking, security products, enterprise network infrastructure, and Windows, macOS, and Linux endpoint management (SCCM, GPO, Intune, MDM, and application management).
* Ability to read and interpret logs and diagnostic output across Windows, macOS, Linux, and Google Kubernetes Engine well enough to coach others and guide technical investigations.

### **Desired**

* Familiarity with adjacent technologies that Cyberhaven integrates with (SIEM, SOAR, UEBA).
* Expertise with DLP, Insider Threat, and CASB solutions.
* Prior experience leading a TAM team at a security or SaaS company.
* Experience working in an early-stage or high-growth company where the team's processes were still being defined.
* Background in L2/L3 or Escalation Engineering for EDR or DLP tools.

Joining Cyberhaven means joining the team building Data Security for the Agentic Enterprise. Traditional tools fall short. Cyberhaven traces the full lifecycle of your data, adapting protection to changing context, so protection moves with the way people actually work, not against it. AI Changed Work. We Protect It.

new_jobs.title: Inventory & Logistics Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
**About the Role**

We are hiring a junior Inventory & Logistics Coordinator in Fremont, CA to maintain accurate inventory, organize stock, coordinate inbound and outbound product movement, and support international and RMA shipments. We design, build, and assemble our devices in-house. This position serves as the operational link between physical inventory, logistics, and the Purchasing department.

The primary focus is inventory control, stock management, and logistics execution. Purchasing is a collaborative support function: this role will communicate stock levels, reorder needs, shipment status, receiving discrepancies, and demand information so Purchasing can make timely buying decisions and prevent stockouts or excess inventory.

**Primary Responsibilities**

*Inventory Control & Stock Management*

* Maintain accurate inventory records in the inventory and ERP platform, ensuring system quantities align with physical stock.
* Count, verify, and document incoming materials, finished products, outgoing shipments, returns, and replacement units.
* Perform routine cycle counts and periodic physical inventory checks; investigate and resolve discrepancies, missing items, and transaction errors.
* Receive parts and materials, complete quality checks for damage or defects, and document vendor or shipment issues.
* Label, organize, and store inventory with clear item identification, location control, and separation of new and existing stock.
* Maintain minimum and safety-stock thresholds for parts, consumables, finished products, repair supplies, and replacement materials.
* Monitor inventory usage and stock movement to identify low-stock, slow-moving, or excess items and recommend appropriate action.
* Organize and maintain both the in-house storage area and offsite storage facility for efficient retrieval and accurate stock visibility.
* Prepare monthly and quarterly inventory reports for Finance and provide inventory status updates to Operations and Purchasing.

*Logistics, Shipping & Receiving*

* Coordinate domestic and international inbound and outbound shipments, including seasonal increases during Q2 and Q4.
* Prepare commercial invoices, packing lists, Certificates of Origin, and other required customs documentation.
* Assign appropriate Harmonized System (HS) codes and support accurate duty, tax, tariff, and landed-cost calculations.
* Coordinate with FedEx, DHL, UPS, USPS, and ShipStation to schedule, track, and troubleshoot shipments.
* Apply Incoterms and destination-country requirements to support compliant international delivery.
* Monitor shipment status, delivery timing, damages, shortages, and carrier exceptions; communicate delays and resolve issues promptly.
* Coordinate RMA repair and replacement shipments, ensuring stock records, customs documents, and delivery details are accurate.
* Package and ship individual devices and kits and, when required, deliver packages to local carrier locations.
* Identify opportunities to reduce freight and total landed costs while maintaining service and compliance.

*Purchasing Department Collaboration*

* Provide Purchasing with accurate stock balances, reorder-point alerts, open shipment status, and anticipated material needs.
* Collaborate with Purchasing to convert approved replenishment needs into timely purchase orders and follow through on delivery status.
* Support material requirements planning (MRP) by sharing inventory usage, stock availability, lead-time concerns, and demand information.
* Track purchase orders in the ERP system and coordinate expediting when materials are at risk of stockout or production delay.
* Reconcile received quantities against purchase orders and packing documents; communicate shortages, overages, damages, and invoice discrepancies.
* Partner with Purchasing and Engineering on occasional sourcing needs, vendor information, and part substitutions.
* Support supplier performance tracking by documenting on-time delivery, quality issues, and recurring receiving discrepancies.
* Coordinate with Purchasing, Finance, Sales, Operations, and warehouse stakeholders to align material availability with business priorities.

**Qualifications & Skills**

* 1+ years of experience in inventory control, stock management, logistics, shipping and receiving, or supply chain operations; 2-3+ years of combined inventory and logistics experience is strongly preferred.
* Hands-on experience maintaining inventory accuracy, managing stock locations, completing counts, and resolving discrepancies.
* Understanding of purchasing workflows, purchase orders, reorder points, lead times, and supplier coordination.
* International shipping or customs documentation experience is preferred.
* Manufacturing operations exposure is a plus.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel is required, along with comfort using Microsoft Office 365.
* Experience with ERP or inventory management systems; Confluence, ShipStation, and FedEx tools are a plus.
* Strong attention to detail, math, organization, documentation, and record-keeping skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and communicate clearly across Purchasing, Operations, Finance, and Engineering.
* Ability to lift and carry up to 50 lbs; most individual shipments weigh approximately 5-10 lbs.
* Reliable transportation for occasional package drop-offs at USPS, FedEx, or UPS locations.
* Able to work in-office Monday-Friday in Fremont, CA.

Pay: $20.00 - $26.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* Health insurance

Work Location: In person

new_jobs.description:
**About us:**

4LEAF, Inc. (4LEAF) is a multi-discipline Firm providing services throughout the United States. For over 20 years, 4LEAF has assisted communities in successfully navigating contract services, leading to fiscally responsible solutions. As one of the industry’s notable providers of planning, building and safety, construction management, and fire consulting services, 4LEAF has an enviable track record of completing complex projects and staffing assignments with both public and private clients. The dedication of our staff combined with our company culture, have consistently allowed us to meet and exceed the needs of our clients.

**Job Description**:

4LEAF is seeking a full-time Proposal Writer/Marketing Assistant for our Pleasanton office. This position requires excellent verbal and written communication skills, strong attention to detail, organization, time management, and the ability to manage multiple deadlines in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

The Marketing Assistant / Proposal Writer will support proposal development, marketing content management, and related marketing initiatives. This role is responsible for assisting with the development, coordination, writing, editing, formatting, production, and delivery of high-quality proposals, qualification packages, presentations, and marketing materials.

The ideal candidate is resourceful, proactive, highly organized, self-directed, and comfortable working with project managers, directors, subject matter experts, and marketing team members to produce accurate, polished, and timely materials.

**Responsibilities:**

**Proposal Development:**

* Review RFPs to identify requirements, deadlines, win themes, and submission criteria.
* Manage the proposal process from RFP receipt through final delivery, coordinating with project managers, directors, and subject matter experts.
* Draft, edit, format, and assemble proposals, qualification packages, presentations, and related submittals.
* Ensure all submissions are client-focused, technically accurate, well-written, and aligned with brand guidelines.
* Develop original content as needed, including project descriptions, staff qualifications, firm experience, and value messaging.

**Content and Data Management:**

* Create and maintain reusable proposal content, including resumes, project descriptions, client data, photos, graphics, and value messaging.
* Support fact-checking, version control, and quality control of marketing content and templates (Word, PowerPoint, Excel, InDesign).
* Maintain digital assets, marketing data, and internal content libraries.

**Marketing Support:**

* Assist in developing marketing communications across print, web, email, social media, and presentations.
* Attend conferences and events to represent 4LEAF, support logistics, and promote services.
* Develop a strong understanding of 4LEAF's service lines — including planning, building and safety, engineering, construction management, inspection, code enforcement, and fire consulting — to produce accurate, compelling content.
* Coordinate events, sponsorships, and promotional materials.
* Maintain marketing tracking systems, collateral inventory, and promotional items.
* Conduct competitive research and other marketing support as directed.

Requirements

**Qualifications / Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree in English, Marketing, Journalism, Communications, or related field preferred.
* 1–3 years of proposal, technical, or marketing writing experience, ideally in B2B/B2G professional services; construction, engineering, or municipal consulting a plus.
* Strong writing, editing, proofreading, and content organization skills with a creative and persuasive voice.
* Solid project management skills — organized, self-directed, able to multi-task and meet deadlines.
* Strong interpersonal skills; able to collaborate effectively with internal teams and subject matter experts.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Publisher, Outlook), including advanced formatting, templates, and styles.
* Knowledge of visual design principles; Adobe Creative Suite (InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop) preferred.
* Experience with digital asset management, CRM, or marketing databases a plus.

**Working Conditions:**

* General office environment.
* Regularly requires working in a seated position at a workstation for extended periods.
* Occasionally may require lifting up to 20 lbs.

**Job Type:**

* Full-time, salaried position
* Monday to Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.
* 15-20% Travel required
* On-site in Pleasanton, CA

**Compensation:**  
4LEAF anticipates paying between $70,304 – $94,200 per year for this position, commensurate with experience.

**Benefits:**

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Employee Assistance Program
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

For more firm information, please visit www.4leafinc.com.

4LEAF, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer.

new_jobs.title: Project Coordinator (Commercial Moving and Furniture Installation)
new_jobs.description:
**About Alliance Transfer**

Alliance Transfer has handled commercial relocations, furniture delivery and installation, warehousing and office decommissioning in the New York metro area since 1986. We run our own trucks and crews out of a Newark warehouse and work in occupied Manhattan office buildings for law firms, financial firms, hospitals, universities and furniture dealers. We are family-owned, non-union, and small enough that good people get noticed fast. Our office admin started in a support seat and now runs our books.

**The job**

You keep every job on the calendar complete and every hour accounted for. Between the time a proposal is signed and the time the invoice goes out, you are the person who makes sure nothing falls through the cracks: the calendar event has the right address, contact, crew count and equipment; the building has our COI; the client has a confirmation; the crew has a bill of lading; and the time sheets match what actually happened.

This is a seat for someone who wants to learn the business from the inside. If you grow into scoping and running jobs, there is a Project Manager path here.

**What you will do**

* Own the Job Schedule calendar: enter every booked job with client, address, contacts, scope, crew count, trucks and equipment
* Build and send bills of lading, crew call sheets and client confirmations before each job
* Collect and reconcile daily time sheets against the schedule; flag gaps and overtime before payroll
* Request and track certificates of insurance, elevator reservations and dock windows with building management
* Keep job folders current: proposals, estimates, floor plans, photos, sign-offs, damage reports
* Be the first-line contact for clients on logistics questions once a job is booked
* Track scope changes and open items on live jobs so nothing is missed at billing
* Support the Operations Manager and Project Manager with proposal prep, site walk notes and meeting follow-ups
* Help with field recruiting paperwork: onboarding, certifications, availability

**What we are looking for**

* 2+ years in a coordinator, scheduler, office or admin role at a moving, logistics, construction, facilities or furniture company
* Detail obsessed; you notice a wrong suite number before anyone else does
* Fast and tidy in Google Workspace (Calendar, Sheets, Docs) and comfortable learning QuickBooks, CompanyCam and HubSpot
* Writes a clean, short email
* Calm on the phone with clients, building staff and crew
* Nice to have: experience with COIs and building logistics in Manhattan, Spanish, interest in moving into project management

**Pay and benefits**

* $52,000 to $65,000 a year, based on experience
* Health and dental insurance
* Paid time off and holidays
* Hybrid after six months
* A real path to Project Manager for the right person

**How to apply**

Apply through Indeed with a resume. Tell us about a time you caught a mistake before it cost somebody money.

Pay: $52,000.00 - $65,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

**Departm****ent**

Melrose Older Adult Center

Non-exempt

Part Time

$23 per hour

Program Director

**MISSION STATEMENT**

East Side House cares for the individuals, families, and communities we serve by expanding opportunities to live more fulfilling lives through education, career, and supportive services.

**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Summary/ Objective**

East Side House (ESH) is a community resource in the Bronx and Northern Manhattan. We believe education is the key that enables all people to create economic and civic opportunities for themselves, their families, and their community. ESH’s Older Adult Programs aligns with our mission by providing high-quality programs and services within community centers and school partnerships.

Reporting to the Program Director, the Program Coordinator will oversee the day-to-day operations of the Melrose Older Adults program and report to East Side House and the funder, the NYC Department for the Aging (DFTA). The Program Coordinator is responsible for staff supervision, recordkeeping and providing a variety of social, protective and supportive services in a non-medical care setting. As a member of the Older Adult team, the Program Coordinator collaborates with the Directors of Melrose and Borinquen Court Older Adult Centers for planning and provision of services in the older adult centers.

**Essential Functions and Responsibilities**

Under the supervision of the Director, the Program Coordinator will be responsible for but not limited to the following:

* Assist with overseeing program staff through weekly supervision and periodical evaluation of staff and support staff to ensure program enhancements, development, commonalities, and uniqueness in all sites.
* Disseminate updated information to staff and participants regarding changes in the policies and procedures affecting rights and entitlements in a timely manner.
* Coordinate and help develop programs for older adult participants in the areas of social, cultural, educational and recreational activities (at least four group activities a day or twenty-six group activities a month must be planned and carried out in compliance with DFTA mandates).
* Coordinate/Create monthly activities calendar.
* Develop and implement outreach plans to ensure maximum utilization of center.
* Recruit volunteer workers (Maturity Works, BEGIN, AARP, Senior volunteers and others).
* Serve as a liaison with community and neighborhood groups that can assist in the process of advancing senior citizen issues.
* Ensure contract compliance as outlined by program work plans and contracts.
* Prepare and submit all program reports to the Program Director in a timely fashion (i.e. monthly level, box money, payroll sheets and attendance; prepare, submit, and review all required center reports).
* Promote older adult participation and involvement in the advisory board, grievance committee, other such committees, and the center.
* Assist in registering new participants in the program.
* Provide case assistance services to seniors (i.e. supportive contact, referrals, benefits and entitlement assistance, immigration assistance, advocacy).
* Direct, coordinate and oversee fundraising activities for older adult programs.
* Coordinate/motivate participation in center activities and congregated lunch.
* Adhere to contractual obligations and compliance updates dictated by multiple government and private funding sources to maintain contract integrity and performance.
* Complete monthly Kitchen Inventory
* Assist with preparation of the DFTA Program and Nutrition assessments/CAP and DOH
* Related tasks as assigned.

**Other Duties**

Social Media Content Creator & Marketing Coordinator

**Babyface Brows | Park Slope, Brooklyn**  
**Part-Time | 15–25 hours/week | $20–$24/hour**

**IMPORTANT: Applications must be submitted online through this posting. Please do not call or visit the studio about the position. Applicants who call or visit in person to apply will not be considered.** If your background looks like a good fit, we’ll contact you directly.

Join Babyface Brows

Babyface Brows is a specialty brow and lash studio in Park Slope, Brooklyn, just steps from Barclays Center. We’re building a beauty brand around expert brows, great lashes, and a thoughtful client experience.

We’re looking for a creative, self-motivated person who can help us make better content, connect with our audience, and grow our presence online.

Your Focus

You’ll help shape how people discover and experience Babyface online. Working directly with management, you’ll turn ideas into content for Instagram, TikTok, and other social platforms.

This is a hands-on creative role to start, with room to take on greater responsibility across marketing as the business grows.

Show Us What You Can Create

**Previous content creation experience is required.** You don’t need to have worked for a company or agency. Content from your own social accounts, school projects, freelance work, personal projects, or a business all count. We want to see that you’ve taken an idea and turned it into something people can watch, read, or engage with.

Day-to-Day ResponsibilitiesCreate, Film & Publish

You’ll help bring a mix of content to life, including:

* Before-and-after transformations
* Educational posts and carousel graphics
* Short-form videos, including Reels, TikToks, skits, and trends
* Stories and interactive content
* Behind-the-scenes footage and everyday studio moments
* New creative concepts that fit our brand and audience

You’ll also be responsible for:

* Researching trends and developing fresh content ideas
* Planning shoots and coordinating with clients and artists
* Filming services, transformations, and team moments
* Helping people feel comfortable and natural on camera
* Editing content using CapCut, Canva, or similar tools
* Preparing and publishing posts across our social channels
* Maintaining a consistent posting schedule and visual style

How You’ll Grow in the Role

Initially, you’ll partner closely with management to produce more content, strengthen its quality, and test new creative approaches.

Over time, we want you to take greater ownership of the process, from planning the content calendar to organizing shoots, editing, publishing, and reviewing performance.

The goal is to build someone who can independently manage day-to-day social content and contribute ideas that help the business grow.

Beyond Social Media

As Babyface expands, this position has the potential to develop into a broader marketing role. Depending on your interests and performance, future responsibilities may include:

* Email campaigns and client communications
* Neighborhood partnerships and community marketing
* Influencer outreach and brand collaborations
* Meta and Google advertising
* Marketing campaigns and promotional materials
* Client surveys, audience segmentation, and performance analysis
* Helping develop and eventually lead a wider marketing function

We’re looking for someone who wants to develop their skills and take on more as the business grows.

The Person We’re Looking For

Professional experience is less important than creativity, initiative, sound judgment, and a willingness to learn.

You’ll be a strong fit if you’re:

* Constantly coming up with new ideas
* Comfortable making short-form videos
* Willing to film and guide people on camera
* Organized and able to manage multiple tasks
* Comfortable working independently and taking initiative
* Familiar with CapCut, Canva, or comparable creative tools
* Interested in beauty, fashion, lifestyle, or digital media
* Curious, adaptable, and willing to experiment

*If you spot a trend and immediately start thinking about how Babyface could put its own spin on it, we’d love to hear from you.*

Pay & Perks

**$20–$24/hour, depending on experience and portfolio**

* Flexible scheduling
* Employee discount
* Referral program
* Potential to take on additional hours and expanded responsibilities over time

How to Stand Out

Include a link to your portfolio or a piece of content you’re proud of in your application. It can be an Instagram account, Reel, TikTok, video, campaign, or personal project. We’re interested in your ideas and execution, not just your résumé.

**Location:** 458 Bergen Street, Brooklyn, NY 11217  
**Work setting:** In person  
**Schedule:** Part-time, 15–25 hours/week

Pay: $20.00 - $24.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Employee discount
* Flexible schedule
* Referral program

Application Question(s):

* Have you created and posted content before? This can be for a business, personal social media, school, freelance work, a side project, or anything else.

Ability to Commute:

* Brooklyn, NY 11217 (Required)

new_jobs.title: Manager, Technical Account Management
new_jobs.description:
**About the Role**
------------------

Cyberhaven is looking for a Manager, Technical Account Management to build and lead the team of Technical Account Managers who own the technical relationship with our customers. Your team is accountable for how each customer deploys, adopts, and gets value from Cyberhaven's Agentic Data Security platform, from onboarding through renewal. You will hire and develop the team, define how TAMs work with accounts, and make sure customers get a consistent, proactive technical partner and experience.

You are a people leader with a technical background in security SaaS and endpoint agents, and you are comfortable in a fast-paced, high-growth environment where the team's processes are still being written. You will coach TAMs on and step in on critical escalations when needed. You will also work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Support Engineering, Customer Experience, and Sales to turn what the team learns from customers into improvements to the product and to how we serve customers.

Technical depth, a strong client focus, and experience leading customer-facing technical teams are required. You will report to the VP of Support and Technical Account Management.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

### **Lead and grow the team**

* Hire, onboard, and develop Technical Account Managers. Set clear expectations, give regular feedback, and run career development and performance reviews.
* Coach TAMs on account strategy, technical troubleshooting, executive communication, and managing difficult customer situations.
* Build a team culture of growth mindset, ownership, curiosity, and accountability for customer outcomes.
* Plan headcount and coverage as the customer base grows, including how accounts are assigned and balanced across the team.

### **Define how the TAM function operates**

* Establish the TAM operating model: account segmentation, coverage, engagement cadence, business review format, and technical success plans.
* Set the team's goals and metrics, such as account health, agent coverage and deployment progress, adoption, escalation volume and time to resolution, and customer satisfaction. Report on them to leadership.
* Create and maintain playbooks, runbooks, and knowledge base standards so TAMs handle common situations the same way.
* Define the handoffs between TAMs and Customer Experience and Sales so customers always know who owns what.

### **Own customer outcomes**

* Review account health across the team's book of business and step in early on accounts at risk of low adoption, deployment problems, or churn.
* Act as the senior escalation point for critical customer issues. Make sure TAMs bring clear reproductions and context to Engineering, and that customers stay informed through resolution.
* Build relationships with customes, and join executive and business reviews for strategic accounts.
* Work with Customer Success and Sales on renewals, expansions, and risk mitigation, providing technical input and account insight.

### **Be the voice of the customer**

* Collect customer feedback, feature requests, and recurring issues from the team and bring them to Product Management and Engineering with the technical and business context behind them.
* Work with Engineering and Support Engineering to improve diagnostics, debugging tools, and escalation processes.
* Run root cause analysis reviews on significant incidents and drive preventive follow-ups so issues do not repeat.
* Stay current on industry trends, security best practices, and adjacent technologies such as SIEM, SOAR, and UEBA, and bring them into the team's guidance to customers.

**Who You Are**
---------------

* 3+ years of experience managing a team of Technical Account Managers, Support Engineers, Solutions Engineers, or similar customer-facing technical staff.
* 7+ years in customer-facing technical roles.
* Track record of hiring, developing, and retaining strong technical people, and of handling performance issues directly and fairly.
* Experience building or scaling a TAM, Support, or Customer Success function, including processes, playbooks, and metrics.
* Demonstrated ability to own customer technical outcomes from implementation through steady-state operation, and to understand a customer's architecture and environment end-to-end.
* Hands-on experience deploying, supporting, and troubleshooting SaaS-based security and/or endpoint agent technologies.
* Proven experience managing escalated technical customer issues and working directly with engineering teams.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills (English), including the ability to engage both hands-on practitioners and executive stakeholders.
* Strong organizational and planning skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, set timelines, and track progress across a team and its accounts.
* Practical knowledge of networking, security products, enterprise network infrastructure, and Windows, macOS, and Linux endpoint management (SCCM, GPO, Intune, MDM, and application management).
* Ability to read and interpret logs and diagnostic output across Windows, macOS, Linux, and Google Kubernetes Engine well enough to coach others and guide technical investigations.

### **Desired**

* Familiarity with adjacent technologies that Cyberhaven integrates with (SIEM, SOAR, UEBA).
* Expertise with DLP, Insider Threat, and CASB solutions.
* Prior experience leading a TAM team at a security or SaaS company.
* Experience working in an early-stage or high-growth company where the team's processes were still being defined.
* Background in L2/L3 or Escalation Engineering for EDR or DLP tools.

Joining Cyberhaven means joining the team building Data Security for the Agentic Enterprise. Traditional tools fall short. Cyberhaven traces the full lifecycle of your data, adapting protection to changing context, so protection moves with the way people actually work, not against it. AI Changed Work. We Protect It.

**About Ramp**
==============

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

* Ability to understand and communicate complex product workflows, integrations, and technical configurations

* Strong executive communication and storytelling skills with the ability to influence cross-functionally and at the C-suite
* Consistent track record of hitting or exceeding revenue targets in fast-paced environments
* Operates with urgency, grit, and ownership; thrives in environments with innovation, change, and ambiguity
* Willingness to travel for customer on-sites, events, and internal team summits

**Nice to Haves**
-----------------

* Experience in financial services sales or selling to finance teams (e.g., Office of the CFO, accounting, controllers, expense management).
* Experience at a high-growth startup

---------------------------------------------------------------

* Weekly coffee stipend

You'll be the trusted advisor to sophisticated operators. You'll build relationships at every level, from owners and VPs to day-to-day teams. You'll use your industry knowledge to help customers get measurable results from the AppFolio Real Estate Performance Management (RPM) platform.

* Protect and grow long-term revenue by positioning AppFolio as a strategic partner and showing continuous, measurable platform ROI.

* Strong gross and net revenue retention across your Strategic portfolio
* Completed Business Reviews and active relationships with key stakeholders

* Early risk identification and measurable gains in platform adoption

* **Influence:** You persuade and negotiate at every level to reach win-win outcomes, and you build consensus across different perspectives.
* **Analytical rigor:** You use data to make decisions and build buy-in. You can size up a situation, define objectives, and recommend a plan.

* Proven record of managing, growing, and retaining strategic, relationship-driven accounts and influencing senior stakeholders

**About Dornier**

Dornier MedTech America (DMTA) is a medical device company dedicated to advancing urology care. As part of the global Dornier MedTech family, we design and manufacture innovative technologies - including laser systems, lithotripters, and endourology devices - trusted by doctors, hospitals, and surgery centers nationwide. Our team is distributed across the U.S., bringing together sales, service, R&D, and operations professionals who share a commitment to improving patient outcomes through better technology.

**Role Overview**

The Sales Operations Manager owns the heartbeat of our commercial operation: the order entry team. In this fast-paced environment, the standard is simple and non-negotiable: every order that can ship today, ships today. This hands-on leader is on the floor, in the queue, and in front of customers, setting the pace and energy for the team while improving how we work so the operation scales as the company grows.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the order queue. Monitor and manage the daily order queue to ensure same-day processing and shipment of all orders. Anticipate bottlenecks, redeploy resources in real time, and personally clear obstacles when the day demands it.

* Lead and develop the team. Manage, coach, and grow the order entry team by setting clear expectations, giving direct feedback, building individual development plans, and creating bench strength as volume grows.

* Drive continuous improvement. Identify and eliminate friction in order entry and fulfillment workflows. Measure cycle times and error rates, standardize best practices, and lead initiatives that let the team handle more volume without more strain.

* Be the face of shipment support. Respond to customer inquiries on orders and shipments with urgency and professionalism, and build processes so common questions are answered before they become calls.

* Report on performance. Track and communicate key operational metrics to leadership, including same-day ship rate, queue aging, order accuracy, and inquiry resolution time, and use them to run the team.

* Partner across functions. Work closely with sales, customer service, warehouse/logistics, and finance to keep the order-to-cash process fast, accurate, and clean.

**Qualifications / What You'll Bring**

**Required**

* Proven experience leading a team in a fast-paced operational environment (order entry, order management, customer operations, fulfillment, or similar).

* A strong, energetic leadership style: you set the pace, hold the standard, and bring the team with you.

* Track record of developing people through coaching, feedback, and building high-performing teams.

* Demonstrated success with continuous improvement: you find a better way and make it stick.

* Excellent customer communication skills and composure under pressure.

* Strong organizational skills and comfort managing competing priorities against hard daily deadlines.

**Preferred**

* Familiarity with Salesforce or a comparable CRM.

* Experience in medical device, healthcare, or another regulated distribution environment.

* Exposure to ERP order management systems and order-to-cash processes.

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance (effective day one of employment)

* Professional development and education support
